words.descriptionTail: A car dashboard live wallpaper for Android: power, CPU clock or GPS speed.
words.liveIntro: This is the real wallpaper, drawn in your browser by the app's own code. Tap the big gauge, and try {name}'s layouts and colours.

paid.title: {price}, once
paid.text: Buy {name} once on Google Play and it's yours. On a new phone with the same Google account, it comes back by itself.

features.title: One dial, three jobs
features.text: The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed. Tap it on your home screen to switch, as in every style.

features.title: Make it yours
features.text: Customize sets {name}'s colours and background, and its units, clock and warning lights.

features.title: Layouts, and your own
features.text: Most styles come in several layouts. You can also drag and resize the gauges and save your own.

words.moreIntro: Every style runs live on its own page. Or try them all in your browser.

styles.name: Classic
styles.tagline: The 2016 dashboard: five gauges, an LCD clock and warning lights.
styles.lead: The original dashboard, live on your phone.
styles.look: Classic is where Speedometer started, in 2016: a big gauge on brushed metal with smaller gauges for battery, RAM, signal and Wi-Fi around it, an LCD clock and a row of warning lights. Steel and Graphite are Classic in new materials.
styles.summary: the original 2016 dashboard with five gauges

styles.name: Steel
styles.tagline: Classic, refined: satin chrome around spun graphite and an ice-white LCD.
styles.look: Steel keeps Classic's gauges and puts them in chrome bezels around spun graphite dials, with a backlit ice-white LCD and its lamps set in chrome rings.
styles.summary: Classic in chrome, spun graphite and an ice-white LCD

styles.name: Graphite
styles.tagline: Classic, flat: a satin ring around a plain graphite dial on a dark background.
styles.look: Graphite is Classic at its plainest: a satin ring around a flat graphite dial on a dark background, with nothing shiny to pull your eye away from your icons.
styles.summary: Classic made flat, with graphite dials on a dark background

styles.name: Future
styles.tagline: The 2016 Future cluster: a chrome dial, the song that's playing, missed calls and messages.
styles.lead: The 2016 cluster, with your music on it.
styles.look: Future is the other style from 2016: a chrome dial in a cluster that also shows the song that's playing, its cover and the volume, and your missed calls and unread messages. Those need notification access, and nothing it reads leaves your phone.
styles.summary: a chrome cluster with your music, calls and messages

styles.name: Carbon
styles.tagline: A race dash: shift lights, the value huge on a race display with a rev bar, and bar meters.
styles.look: Carbon is a race car's dash on fine twill carbon fibre: shift lights across the top, the reading huge on a race display with a bar under it, and bar meters for the rest, in white italic numbers with a red line.
styles.summary: a race dash with shift lights on carbon fibre

styles.name: Vintage
styles.tagline: A 1960s dashboard: a cream speedometer and a matching clock over a chrome-rimmed walnut console.
styles.look: Vintage is a 1960s sports car's dashboard: a cream enamel dial in a knurled chrome bezel and a matching clock over a walnut console, with drum counters and jewel lamps in chrome cups.
styles.summary: a 1960s dashboard in walnut, chrome and cream enamel

styles.name: Amber Night
styles.tagline: Night luxury: one big amber-lit dial over a dot-matrix information display.
styles.look: Amber Night is a luxury car's dash after dark: one big dial lit amber from its rim in a smoked black-chrome bezel, over an amber dot-matrix display on black quilted leather. Everything glows amber, and warnings glow orange-red.
styles.summary: a luxury night dash lit amber, with a dot-matrix display

styles.name: Rally
styles.tagline: Racing: a big white tacho, a rally computer's reflective LCD and a strip of small dials.
styles.look: Rally is a rally car's instruments: a big white dial in a black knurled ring over a honeycomb grille, a rally computer's reflective LCD with black segments, and a strip of small dials.
styles.summary: rally instruments with a rally computer's LCD

styles.name: Glass
styles.tagline: A HUD: glowing cyan arcs and thin digits floating in brackets, no round gauges.
styles.look: Glass has no round gauges at all: glowing cyan arcs and thin, letter-spaced digits float in corner brackets over smoked glass and faint scan lines. Warnings glow pink-red.
styles.summary: a glowing cyan head-up display with no round gauges

styles.name: Cockpit
styles.tagline: An aircraft panel: caption lights, luminous drum counters and a clock on a riveted plate.
styles.look: Cockpit is an aircraft's instrument panel: a matte black dial in a crinkle bezel with four screws, luminous drum counters in recessed windows, caption lights such as a lit green ON, and a clock on a riveted plate.
styles.summary: an aircraft panel with caption lights and drum counters

styles.name: Harbour
styles.tagline: Marine instruments: brass rope-edge bezels around navy enamel on a teak deck, a gold needle and brass-framed counters.
styles.look: Harbour is a boat's instrument panel: brass bezels with a rope edge around navy enamel dials on a teak deck, a gold needle, and counters in brass frames.
styles.summary: marine brass and navy enamel gauges on a teak deck

styles.name: Track Night
styles.tagline: A race screen: a rev ladder, the value huge on an electric-blue band, and shift lights closing in from both sides.
styles.look: Track Night is a modern race car's screen: a ladder of bars across the top, the reading huge on an electric-blue band, and shift lights that close in from both sides as it climbs.
styles.summary: a race screen with shift lights, in electric blue

styles.name: Torque
styles.tagline: A muscle-car dash: a curved rev arc with a red shift zone, a big round dial on gunmetal, the time as a framed gear number, and fuel and temperature arcs.
styles.look: Torque is a muscle car's dash on gunmetal: a curved arc with a red zone across the top, a big round dial under it, the time framed like a gear number, and two side arcs drawn as fuel and temperature.
styles.summary: a muscle-car dash with a big round dial on gunmetal

styles.name: Circuit
styles.tagline: The track look: glowing blue sweeps on deep black, three small round gauges between the rev arc and the dial, and crisp thin digits.
styles.look: Circuit is a track car's cluster: glowing blue sweeps on deep black, three small round gauges between the top arc and the big dial, and crisp thin digits.
styles.summary: a track car cluster of glowing blue sweeps on black

styles.name: Prism
styles.tagline: An angular tech cluster: two slanted panels of faceted glass, blue for the reading and red for the revs, with tilted bar scales and a thin neon outline.
styles.look: Prism is an angular tech cluster: two slanted panels of faceted glass, one blue and one red, with tilted bar scales and a thin neon outline.
styles.summary: an angular cluster of faceted blue and red glass

styles.name: Aura
styles.tagline: Premium sport dials: chrome rings, a warm glow behind white numerals and big digital numbers, on graphite leather.
styles.look: Aura is a premium sports car's dials: chrome rings with a warm glow behind white numerals, and big digital numbers, all on graphite leather.
styles.summary: premium sport dials with chrome rings on graphite leather

styles.name: Pulse
styles.tagline: A neon HUD of rings: every reading a ring of light around the big number, magenta on black.
styles.look: Pulse turns every reading into a ring of light around the big number, magenta on black.
styles.summary: a neon HUD of magenta rings on black

styles.name: Vector
styles.tagline: A neon HUD in hexagons: a faceted sweep that thickens as it climbs and crisp thin digits, violet on black.
styles.look: Vector is a neon HUD built from hexagons: a faceted sweep that thickens as the reading climbs, and crisp thin digits, violet on black.
styles.summary: a neon HUD of violet hexagons on black

styles.name: Horizon
styles.tagline: A fighter jet's head-up display: sliding tapes, the value boxed between them and a time strip, green on black.
styles.lead: A fighter jet's HUD, in green on black.
styles.look: Horizon is a fighter jet's head-up display: the readings slide past on tapes, the big value sits boxed between them, and a strip shows the time, all green on black.
styles.summary: a fighter jet's head-up display, green on black
